explanation: Russia opened negotiations at Portsmouth in August 1905 with the revolution seven months old, the Black Sea fleet mutinying and the countryside burning, and accepted terms that a government secure at home would have gone on fighting rather than sign: Korea, the Liaodong lease, southern Sakhalin. The claim is that the revolution is why Russia settled in 1905 rather than in 1906. It does not say the revolution is why Russia lost: Japan was near the end of its credit and Roosevelt was pressing both sides, and either would have brought the war to an end in time.
